title: Turn snack time into your toddler's favorite treat
summary: SAVE this for Halloween snack prep! Your toddler will LOVE making (and eating) these!

caption: 💌SAVE this for Halloween 🎃 snack prep! Your toddler will LOVE making (and eating) these! Turn snack time into your toddler's favorite treat! Soft, healthy, and fun ... these monster cookies are perfect 👌 for little hands and picky eaters! Ingredients: 12/3 cups (200g) whole wheat flour 1/3 cup (100g)soft butter 1egg 6 figs (soaked and mashed) 1/2 tsp vanilla 1/4 tsp cinnamon Steps: - Preheat the oven to 180℃(350°F) - Mix butter + mashed figs until smooth. - Add egg,flour, vanilla, cinnamon + mix gently.  - Roll out the dough with a rolling pin (1/2 cm thick)& cut with a round cookie cutter. - Decorate faces: use a spoon for mouths/nostrils, round objects for eyes. -Bake 12-15 minutes until lightly golden 💡 Tips: Don't overmix → cookies stay soft Let cool slightly before serving → toddlers handle easily Have fun with decorations → make snack time playful & stress-free #toddlernutrition  #healthyhalloween #toddlersnacks #figs #spookytreats
